تستقطرن (form X)
# تَسْتَقْطِرْنَ (tastaqṭirna) /tas.taq.tˤir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
# تُسْتَقْطَرْنَ (tustaqṭarna) /tus.taq.tˤar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
